title: Non-blocking follow-ups from backend-day-trader-timeframe-mode PR #309 review
description: Non-blocking findings from the pr-reviewer pass on backend-day-trader-timeframe-mode's PR #309, tracked here so they aren't lost once that PR merges (see PR #309's review comment for full context on each). The one blocking finding from that review -- PUT /api/settings/trading-mode not ignoring day_trader_timeframe_triple when mode='swing' -- is recorded directly on backend-day-trader-timeframe-mode's own review.comments and must be fixed on that task/PR itself, not here.

checklist.step: Fix stale '3x-8x' guideline-band wording in three places (app/signals/timeframe.py's factor_of_five_warnings() message text, app/api/schemas.py's TimeframeTripleOut.factor_of_five_warnings field description, and a test comment in tests/unit/signals/test_timeframe.py) to match the actually-implemented 2x-10x band (_FACTOR_OF_FIVE_MIN_RATIO/_MAX_RATIO in app/signals/timeframe.py).

Fix app/api/routers/settings.py's module docstring, which references a follow-up task id 'backend-day-trader-timeframe-mode-intraday-signal-engine' that doesn't exist -- should reference backend-day-trader-timeframe-mode-ibkr-intraday and backend-day-trader-timeframe-mode-signal-engine (the two actual follow-up tasks).
Fix docs/architecture/Backend.md's day-trader-timeframe-mode section numbering -- it's numbered '## 11.' immediately after the existing '## 9.', skipping 10.

Add a test to TestFactorOfFiveWarnings (tests/unit/signals/test_timeframe.py) pinning the factor-of-five band's exact boundary ratios (2.0x and 10.0x) to confirm the inclusive/exclusive comparison in factor_of_five_warnings() behaves as intended.
